beats.text: Months on. The partnership's underway, and Dave wants to look further back.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Before any of this — the workshop. I've been building furniture on weekends for two years and never told anyone at work."

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You turn over the top card.

options.text: Something's been growing quietly underneath it all.
It means you wasted years on something pointless.
The past doesn't really factor into a reading.

elaboration: The Empress here points at something that was already alive before you told a single person about it — quietly, out of view.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Was I wrong to keep it to myself this whole time?"

options.text: No — protecting it quietly was caring for yourself first.
Yes, hiding things from people you trust is wrong.
Whether you were wrong isn't something a reading can say.

elaboration: The Empress's other message: care for yourself first. Keeping something safe while it's still forming counts.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Okay. Let's put the whole thing together."
